name: contract-desktop-audio-transcript
goal: Keep Desktop audio transcript aligned with the exact playable fixture bytes

evidence: Desktop renders a tone description for its sealed one-second silent WAV; its transcript must describe silence.

The shared Reports fixture changed its synthetic transcript but Desktop inherited it while replacing the bytes with silence; its existing component and browser cases still assert the old text and did not bind content to the bytes.
The existing component case failed on the incorrect tone transcript for the silent fixture; two companion cases passed.
